title: List Quick Action Request
description: Runs a server-defined quick action of a list on one record. The client names the page, the record (in the path), the action (in the path) and the version of the record it saw; the server decides what is assigned.

page_id.description: The page the list is on.

expected_version.description: The record version the action is based on (the `version` the client last received). An action based on an older version is refused with 409 and nothing is written.

preview.description: Act on the draft of the page instead of its published version. Only for a signed-in person who may read the draft; it must match what the person is looking at (the page endpoint's `preview`). Without it the published version is used. The page access rights, the live data and the permissions stay the same.
